financeNote.label: Note from Finance
financeNote.unclear: The transfer slip was too blurred to read. Please upload a clearer photo or the bank's PDF advice.

bank.title: Bank transfer details
bank.fictional: Fictional account for this demo. Do not send real money.
bank.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the IBAN and copy it yourself.

pay.title: Pay or upload proof
pay.description: Choose an instalment, then upload your bank transfer proof or try the online payment simulation.
pay.rule: Sending proof does not mark the instalment paid. Finance checks it first, usually within 2 working days.

upload.referenceHint: As printed on your slip, for example FT26 1234 5678.
upload.fileHint: Photo or PDF of the transfer slip, up to 5 MB. In this prototype the file never leaves your device.

online.banner: Simulation: no payment gateway is contacted and no money moves.
online.body: This shows how paying online will work. Like a bank transfer, it ends at “Awaiting verification” until Finance confirms the money arrived.

done.title: Awaiting verification
done.uploadBody: We received your proof for {{label}}. It stays unpaid until Finance verifies it; your receipt will then appear under Payments.
done.onlineBody: The simulated online payment for {{label}} was recorded. Nothing was charged, and it stays unpaid until Finance verifies it.

nothing.title: Nothing to pay right now
nothing.body: Every instalment is paid or awaiting verification.

pay.notPayable: {{label}} is {{status}}, so there is nothing to pay. Choose another instalment.

receipt.title: Payment receipt
receipt.missingBody: Choose a receipt from your payments.
receipt.prototype: Prototype receipt · fictional data · not valid for tax or legal use

construction.title: Construction progress
construction.yourTower: Your tower (Tower {{tower}}) was handed over on {{date}}. Work continues on the rest of the project.

slab.title: Tower {{tower}}: level {{floor}} slab poured
slab.body: The concrete slab for level {{floor}} was poured and is curing. Columns for the next level start next week.

facade.title: Tower {{tower}}: facade mock-up approved
facade.body: The full-size facade panel passed weather and finish checks. Installation starts from the lower floors in December.

clubhouse.title: Clubhouse and pool: structure complete
clubhouse.body: The clubhouse frame and pool shell are complete. Waterproofing and services work have started.

towerC.title: Tower {{tower}}: level {{floor}} reached
towerC.body: Tower {{tower}} has reached level {{floor}} on schedule. Brickwork continues on the floors below.

interiors.title: Tower {{tower}}: show apartment fitted out
interiors.body: A finished show apartment is ready in Tower {{tower}} so future owners can see the final specification.

documents.previewBanner: Prototype preview: a fictional document built from demo data. It is not a legal document and cannot be downloaded.
documents.previewIntro: Larkspur Estates (Demo) confirms the following details for the owner named below.

services.title: Services

services.simulatedCall: Prototype: no call was placed. The live app would call {{name}}.
services.simulatedWhatsApp: Prototype: WhatsApp was not opened. The live app would message {{name}}.

maintenance.emptyBody: Report a leak, a faulty switch or anything else that needs fixing.
maintenance.nextStep: The facilities team will confirm a visit time.

form.title: New maintenance request
form.intro: Tell the facilities team what needs fixing. This is a demo: no team is notified.
form.descriptionHint: Where it is and what happens, in a sentence or two.

maintenance.created: Request {{ref}} sent to the facilities team.

visitors.emptyBody: Create a pass and share the gate code with your guest.
visitors.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Read the code out to your guest instead.
visitors.showAtGate: Your guest shows this code to security at the main gate.

form.title: New visitor pass
form.intro: Your guest gives the gate code to security. This is a demo: no gate system is updated.

tour.name: Your owner portal
tour.summary: Eight short stops: your property, the next instalment, paying, receipts, construction and where to find help.

hero.title: This is your property
hero.body: Your unit, your role as owner and the project it belongs to. The photo is illustrative.

nextInstalment.title: Your next instalment
nextInstalment.body: The amount and due date of the next payment in your plan, with its current status.

payActions.title: Pay or upload proof
payActions.body: Upload your bank transfer proof, or try the online payment simulation. Either way the instalment shows “Awaiting verification” until Finance confirms it, never “Paid” straight away.

quickActions.title: Quick actions
quickActions.body: One tap to the things owners do most: pay, receipts, maintenance, visitor passes, documents and construction progress.

receipts.title: Recent receipts
receipts.body: Every payment Finance has verified, with its receipt. The green edge and the “Paid” label mean it is confirmed.

construction.title: Construction progress
construction.body: How far the project has come, its milestones and the latest site update.

navigation.title: Getting around
navigation.body: The side navigation takes you to payments, construction, documents and services.
navigation.bodyMobile: The bottom bar takes you anywhere. The round button in the middle is the quickest way to pay or upload proof.

help.title: Help is always here
help.body: Replay this tour from here at any time. You can also change language or accessibility settings.

errors.notPayable: This instalment can't be paid now: it is already paid or awaiting verification.
